verdict.rationale: Unleash's own pricing page lists "Export/import feature flags for easy migration," a first-party export feature aimed at leaving or moving instances, so the story partly applies. That export is documented only for feature flags, not all data, and no export format (e.g., JSON) is named. The Admin API's programmatic access to all resources is only a building block for an export, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: export covering all data (users, projects, audit logs, metrics), documented open export formats, detailed export docs, independent or hands-on confirmation of a full migration out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export/import feature flags for easy migration
